task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First of all, ensure that the gateway is open. Then, go west. And then, make it so that the hatch inside the vault is opened. After that, head west. And then, make an effort to go north. Then, go to the east. Then, recover the passkey from the floor of the garage. That's it!
